name: PATN1 (leopard pattern)
summary: Pattern-1, the first established modifier of the leopard complex, associated with a variant in the 3' untranslated region of RFWD3 on chromosome 3. It sets how much white an LP horse shows and is dominant in that: one LP copy plus PATN1 is usually a leopard or near-leopard, and LP/LP plus PATN1 a fewspot or near-fewspot. On a horse with no LP it does nothing and cannot be seen, so a solid horse can carry it and pass it on. It does not cause night blindness, which needs two copies of LP.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Carried, but silent on its own - it only shapes the pattern of a horse that also carries the leopard complex.
